class.name: HTMLKeyboardEvent
class.description: Delivered to the focused element, or to the document body when no element has focus. Cancelling [code]keydown[/code] suppresses the built-in handling for the same press, including focus traversal with Tab, activation with Enter and Space, and text insertion in focused fields. Key events are not delivered while an input method is composing text.

members.member: The layout-dependent key code, using the [enum Key] values, or [code]0[/code] when unavailable.
The layout-independent physical key code, using the [enum Key] values.
The label of the key in the user's layout, using the [enum Key] values.
The Unicode code point produced by the press, or [code]0[/code] for non-printing keys.
Whether the event repeats because the key is held down.
